topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I heard the words, and they settled softly within me, like the quiet after rain. It’s curious, this twist of time, to find that my childhood best friend no longer recalls the afternoons we spent chasing fireflies under the lowering sky. Instead of questions, I felt a gentle acceptance, as if the days we shared were now my own constellations, private and luminous, needing no verification. We spoke of other things, the sky above us shifting from day to dusk, and in the space between the words, I found a new kind of understanding.
